Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a collision in a parking lot in Houston, Texas, where Driver 1 reported a wrist fracture from the
impact. Driver 1 was seated in the vehicle when officers arrived, and Passenger, who was also present, confirmed
this. The injury described is consistent with the force expected from a collision of this type. Photographs tkaen at the
scene show some of the details Driver 1 described, but no independent witnesses were located. On inspection, the
damage to Driver 2's vehicle sits on a different side and at a different height than the impact Driver 1 described, and
the account given does not fully match the damage observed. No prior damage to the vehicle was known to officers
or to the parties. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy covering the vehicle. Officers documented the
scene, collected the photographs, and recorded statements from all parties present for the follow-up review.
